request.context: We are extending a frozen numerical astrophysics ODE program without changing its equations or tolerances. For a fixed immutable fixture, E_i(x)=q_i exp(-x), K_ij(x)=s c n_H0 exp(-3 x) sigma_j(E_i(x)), and H(x)=H0 sqrt(Omega_m exp(-3x)+Omega_r exp(-4x)+Omega_L) are independent of gas, optical depth and ledger state. We want to memoize only exact typed binary64 clamped epoch values, preserving original floating-point evaluation on misses and returning owned array copies on hits. We need symbolic checks of functional independence, dimensions, epoch sensitivity and a cost break-even identity; this is not a proof about floating-point implementation. Separately, independent bounded native jobs form a precedence DAG. For unit-processor jobs on P identical processors, total work W and critical path L give lower bound max(W/P,L) and greedy list-scheduling bound W/P+(1-1/P)L. Actual admission must honor CPU affinity/cgroup sets excluding protected CPU55, current allocation, memory limits and nested thread ceilings. Please provide relevant Wolfram Language tools for exact symbolic differentiation, inequality simplification, finite counterexamples and dimension checking. We will not run new native chemistry or ODE integrations in this theory task.
